_comment: Realistic chat prompts for the LFM3-Omni repetition study (eng/lfm3/loop). Each case has one or more user turns (a multi-turn case sends each turn with the model's earlier replies as history). media: file names under the run's --media directory, attached to the first turn. Mirrored en/zh sets.

Summarize the following text in three sentences:

The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the late 18th century and spread to Europe and North America. It marked a shift from hand production to machines, new chemical manufacturing and iron production processes, the increasing use of steam power and water power, and the development of machine tools. Textiles were the dominant industry in terms of employment, value of output and capital invested. The revolution brought about unprecedented growth in population and income, but also harsh working conditions, child labour and urban overcrowding. Over time, reforms improved working conditions, and the economic changes laid the foundations of the modern world.

工业革命于18世纪末在英国开始，随后扩展到欧洲和北美。它标志着从手工生产向机器生产的转变，出现了新的化学制造和钢铁生产工艺，蒸汽动力和水力的使用越来越多，机床也得到了发展。纺织业在就业、产值和投资方面都是最主要的行业。这场革命带来了前所未有的人口和收入增长，但也带来了恶劣的工作条件、童工和城市过度拥挤。随着时间的推移，改革改善了工作条件，这些经济变化奠定了现代世界的基础。
